issues.issue: This is the Enterprise (water) fund's only receipt, so it is almost certainly water charges (Utility Charges). The printed label says Other, so leaving it in other can be defended. Business-type receipts are 100% other.

The county treasurer balance is printed below the statement, outside the cash totals, and is not in the balance sheet (only mentioned in notes). It is held for the village and may count as an asset (Cash and Cash Equivalents).
